newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DESCHAMPS DOUBTFUL FOR DUTCH FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DESCHAMPS DOUBTFUL FOR DUTCH FRIENDLY.

text.p: Midfielder Didier Deschamps could miss France's friendly against the Netherlands at the Parc des Princes on Wednesday because of a painful calf muscle.

French medical staff said Deschamps of Italian first division Juventus had been given treatment to try to get him fit for a match which is part of the team's build-up for next year's World Cup finals in France.
"Our main problem is Didier Deschamps, who has a painful calf. Given his role and his importance in the squad, it is very annoying," team manager Aime Jacquet said.
"But Didier is not the kind of player who would miss a match if he were fit to play."
Juventus drew 1-1 at Fiorentina on Sunday. Jacquet said the Turin club's other Frenchman, midfielder Zinedine Zidane, was also slightly injured.
